yaml.subtitle: Help sustain the first botanical garden of Mar del Plata

markdown.headingText: Become a Friend of the Arboretum
markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
Arboretum Home The Collection Map Self-guided tour Wellbeing Visit Sponsor a tree Donate Companies Contact Book a visit Español ▸
``` Mar del Plata **never had a botanical garden**. Now it does: a living, 33-hectare arboretum with more than **300 species**, every tree **documented and traceable**, and international recognition ([ArbNet Level I](https://arbnet.org/morton-register/la-constancia-de-biocca/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} · [BGCI](https://gardensearch.bgci.org/garden/7214){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}). Sustaining it and opening it to the community has a cost — and your gift makes it possible. ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} **Your gift goes 100% to the arboretum:** care of the collections, education, research and conservation of the natural heritage. Open data, traceable impact, no greenwashing. ::: The best way to help is a **monthly gift**: small, steady, and it gives the project predictability. Join the community that sustains the garden. ```{=html}
Become a Friend (monthly)
Make a one-time gift
``` ### Friendship levels ::: grid ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} ### 🌱 Seed **Accessible gift** - Your name on the site's **Wall of Friends**. - Newsletter with arboretum news. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} ### 🌿 Sprout **Everything above, plus:** - Early access to events and walks. - Digital Friend certificate. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm style="border-top:3px solid #1E4A38;"} ### 🌳 Tree **Everything above, plus:** - A **guided visit** for two, once a year. - A mention on our social media. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} ### 🌲 Forest **Everything above, plus:** - Featured recognition. - Ideal for families or small companies. ::: ::: ::: {.callout-tip} Would you rather support a specific specimen than give in general? You can [**sponsor a tree**](sponsor.html) in your name, as a gift or in honour of someone. ::: ## What your gift funds Every contribution turns into something concrete that improves the garden and the visitor's experience: ::: grid ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} 🪧 **Educational signage** and species identification. ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Interpretive trails** and accessibility. ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} 🌱 **Nursery and new collections**: propagation and planting. ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **School scholarships**: educational visits for schools. ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Wildlife monitoring** and scientific survey. ::: ::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} 🪑 **Benches and spaces** for rest and observation. ::: ::: ## Ways to give ::: grid ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### From abroad (PayPal) Give in your currency, one-time or monthly: Donate with PayPal ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm} ### From Argentina Local donors can also give through Cafecito / bank transfer — see the [Spanish page](../donar.html) or write to us. ::: ::: ## Why trust us ::: grid ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Full traceability**
One profile and one QR code per tree. Open, verifiable data. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **International recognition**
Accredited by ArbNet (Level I) and in the global BGCI network. ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} **Real local impact**
The first botanical garden of Mar del Plata, open to the community. ::: ::: ## Wall of Friends Those who sustain the arboretum have their place here. **Join and be among the first to appear.** *Coming soon: the list of Friends of the Arboretum.* ::: {.cta-band} ## Questions, or want to arrange your gift? Write to us and we'll gladly help. **Email:** [laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com) · **WhatsApp:** [+54 9 11 5736 0940](https://wa.me/5491157360940) :::
